summary: Tested Management Dashboard (لوحة القيادة) feature end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passing covering admin dashboard structure, period switching (day/week/month + invalid fallback), RBAC for admin/dean/dept-head/teacher, manual scope filter with cross-scope 403s, and PDF/Excel exports. Frontend: verified admin dashboard renders with correct KPIs (students=91, rate=87.7%), scope label 'كل الجامعة', 5 alerts with expected counts (low_attendance=2, missed_today=1, late_teachers=1, cancelled=5, pending_fees=1), scope filter (faculty+dept pills), period switching, alert expansion, faculty pill filter (updates to students=19 for كلية الشريعة والقانون), and PDF/Excel downloads with proper Arabic filenames ('لوحة القيادة - كل الجامعة - آخر 7 أيام - ...pdf/xlsx'). RBAC verified for Salim (dean, filter shows only 3 dept pills + all, no faculty pills), Saeed (dept head, no scope filter, 72 students, correct scope 'الدراسات الإسلامية'), and teacher 9999 (no management-dashboard rendered). No console pageerrors on dashboard.

minor.issue: scope.label has trailing whitespace when manual filter applied (e.g. 'كلية الشريعة والقانون ' with trailing space) — inconsistent with the initial label which is .strip()'ed. In _resolve_scope, the label assignments inside the faculty_id/department_id branches use raw name without .strip(). Frontend still renders correctly but exact-match consumers/tests break.

issues: Non-blocking React Native Web deprecation warnings in console (shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents, onResponder* handlers, TouchableMixin). No functional impact but noisy.

action_items: (Minor) Strip whitespace from scope.label in _resolve_scope for faculty_id/department_id branches (management_dashboard.py L65, L71) for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: management_dashboard.py is 528 lines — approaching the 700-line limit; consider splitting _build_pdf/_build_excel/_finance into separate modules for maintainability.
Label stripping inconsistency between admin/default branch (uses .strip()) and manual filter branches (no strip) → data hygiene bug.
_scope_courses limits to 20000 and lectures.to_list(50000) — hardcoded caps; document expected scale or use aggregation cursors for future-proofing.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing _dash_fixture:true seeded data as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend & frontend for Management Dashboard verified against all requirements in the review. Only cosmetic minor: trailing-space in scope.label under manual filter. Frontend RN-Web deprecation warnings are pre-existing, not feature-related. Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_management_dashboard.py.
rca of the issue: Trailing whitespace bug — In _resolve_scope, initial label uses `.strip()` (lines 58-60) but faculty_id branch (`label = next((f['name']...))`) and department_id branch (`label = sel[0]['name']`) do not strip. Since department documents were seeded with trailing spaces in name, the manual-filter label carries them through. Fix: wrap both assignments in `.strip()`.
